author: Bobby Grayson
title: Extended: one finding per (helper, family), not one per helper. Reporting only the FIRST blocker inside a helper swapped one fiction for another -- LoomWeb.TeamCostComponent read 'distance 2: float literal, operator /' when behind those sit CostTracker.get_call_history/2, DateTime.diff/add and Enum.group_by. Per family it reads distance 8, and EnsembleWeb.SentryLive 13 instead of 2. Call sites still collapse into the helper (that was a deliberate earlier decision and stays), so the unit of a blocker is now 'one feature, in one helper'. This RAISES the blocker count without the translator having got worse: the old number was hiding 40 modules' remote surface behind a single line each.
